summary: Two-phase cleanup. First phase resets device parameters for every slot: gated on the slot count this+0x13B0 being greater than zero, it walks the parameter table starting at this+4472 in 17-DWORD steps and calls StateParameterSetterWithVirtualDeviceNotify on each entry with a null second argument. Second phase, only when a2 is non-null, walks a linked list of resource groups (head via a2+272 then the node pointer at +40, next pointer at DWORD index 23) and for every group whose item count at DWORD index 19 exceeds zero, walks the items in 96-byte steps calling UICleanupIterator on each item whose flag at (DWORD index 21)+24 has bit 0x80000 clear.

local_names.this: object owning the parameter table and slot count
local_names.a2: resource-list owner traversed in the second phase
local_names.v3: slot index for the parameter reset loop
local_names.i: current resource-group node in the linked list
local_names.v7: item index within the current group

operations.description: First phase only runs when the slot count this+0x13B0 is greater than zero
First loop walks the parameter table starting at this+4472 in 17-DWORD steps, once per entry counted by this+0x13B0
StateParameterSetterWithVirtualDeviceNotify invoked on each parameter-table entry with a null second argument to reset device state
Second phase requires a2 to be non-null before the resource-group list is traversed
Loads the head of the resource-group chain: reads the node pointer at a2+272 and dereferences +40 to obtain the first group node
Outer loop walks the group linked list, advancing through the next pointer at DWORD index 23 until it becomes null
Each group is processed only when its item count at DWORD index 19 is greater than zero
Inner loop walks group items in 96-byte steps; only items whose flag at (DWORD index 21)+24 has bit 0x80000 clear are selected for cleanup
UICleanupIterator called on each non-protected item together with the owning object
Returns a2 when it is null, otherwise the last traversed result value
Invoked by sub_4A0250, RenderTargetCleanup and sub_554F80 as a shared cleanup path
